_note: The Empire technology tree — machine-readable twin of EMPIRE_TREE.md (docs/generation/trees/).
Grammar: TREES.md. Lint: node tools/session/tree_lint.js empire — enforces the five rules, the
64-node cap, the spire shape, fork symmetry, reachability, and the doc/store cross-check both ways.
Edit a table in the doc, update this store, run the lint.
Ids are EM-<branch>-<ring><seq>; 'm' is the one milestone per ring, on the spire (SP).
links list each undirected edge ONCE, from the lower id. cost = base(kind) x ring, never stored.
per_mille magnitudes are authored by judgement and are PLACEHOLDERS, as the works magnitudes are.
pursued_when is the scorer's per-node specification: the term that makes this node the top pick,
and the one-line state of the world in which that happens. Terms are in scorer_terms and defined

branches.name: The Spire — Institutions
branches.concern: the sovereign counts, promises, administers; every polity climbs it

branches.name: Roads
branches.concern: reach — how far a seat can supply and govern, over land and across water

branches.name: Arms
branches.concern: muster and metal — what a seat can field, and what it can hold against

branches.name: Harvest
branches.concern: food and stores — what the hinterland yields and what the seat keeps

branches.name: Peoples
branches.concern: holding what was taken — assimilation, cohesion, health, the record

nodes.name: Codified Law & Census

pursued_when.situation: The root. Held by every polity the moment the tree unlocks; a levy can be counted, so it can be raised.

nodes.earth_ref: the Stage 1 floor; codified law and a census are the classical state's first instruments

nodes.name: The Written Ledger

pursued_when.situation: The sovereign counts a fed hinterland it can reach, therefore the sovereign can promise. Ring 2 opens.

nodes.earth_ref: census + surplus + a road to collect it

nodes.name: Coinage at Scale

pursued_when.situation: The seat's stores cannot pay the levy the scorer wants, and there is ore in the hinterland to strike.

nodes.earth_ref: monetised economies; stores become fungible

nodes.name: The Sworn Province

pursued_when.situation: A seat rules ground it cannot see: governors, posted roads, and a granary doctrine taken either way. Ring 3 opens.

nodes.earth_ref: provincial administration at distance

nodes.name: Endowed Scholarship

pursued_when.situation: Nothing binds: stores steady, no grudge pressing, holdings inside reach. Research compounds, so the polity buys the rate.

nodes.earth_ref: endowed institutions of learning; institutional memory outlives rulers

nodes.name: The Lettered Court

pursued_when.situation: A fed realm whose accounts are kept in figures; the court can plan a year ahead. Ring 4 opens.

nodes.earth_ref: arithmetic + rotation: the calculable estate

nodes.name: Credit Instruments & Double Entry

pursued_when.situation: Campaigns outrun what the seat holds; a promise to pay later is cheaper than a store, and the court can now keep the books.

nodes.earth_ref: bills of exchange; the seed of capital disciplining the sovereign

nodes.name: The Enforceable Promise

pursued_when.situation: An entity that outlives its members can own, sue and be sued, and the realm is mapped. The rim: the Industry tree opens when pass 2 does.

nodes.earth_ref: contract law reaches capital — the Charter Age apex

nodes.name: Engineered Road Network

pursued_when.situation: Holdings sit past free_holdings and the burden of breadth charges supply every round; the road is the cheapest relief there is.

nodes.earth_ref: imperial road nets; maintained ways

nodes.name: Road Surveys

pursued_when.situation: Same pressure as the road; taken on the way to the posted road at ring 2.

nodes.earth_ref: milestones and surveyed alignments

nodes.name: Way Stations & Post

pursued_when.situation: A campaign target lies just past sustainable reach — the scorer wants a seat it cannot stage against.

nodes.earth_ref: relay posts; news and supply on a schedule

nodes.name: Deep-Hull Sail

effects.target: strait leg — campaign and settle across a narrow water

pursued_when.situation: The seat holds a coast and the nearest unheld or hostile region is across water the polity cannot yet stage over.

nodes.earth_ref: coasting trade; deep hulls for cargo

nodes.name: Span Bridges

pursued_when.situation: Holdings cut by rivers; the terrain-weighted supply term is what binds. The masonry from the wall circuit is what makes it possible — the cross-link.

nodes.earth_ref: arched stone spans; masonry into roads

nodes.name: Passes & Causeways

pursued_when.situation: The polity's holdings are cut by highland or marsh and the terrain term dominates its supply figure.

nodes.earth_ref: engineered mountain passes, raised causeways over wet ground

nodes.name: Lateen & Long-Range Rig

effects.target: open-sea leg — staging across a sea rather than a strait

pursued_when.situation: A rival's seat, or empty ground, lies across a sea leg; the strait rig cannot stage it.

nodes.earth_ref: ocean-capable coasting rigs

nodes.name: Caravan Halts

pursued_when.situation: Stacks starve on the march where they are not adjacent to owned ground; halts extend what a column finds.

nodes.earth_ref: waystation provisioning on trunk routes

nodes.name: Ocean-Rated Hulls

effects.target: far leg — the long crossing pass 2 needs for colonisation across water

pursued_when.situation: The polity holds every coast it can reach and its sea-facing rivals are beyond the open-sea leg.

nodes.earth_ref: the cog-to-carrack line; hulls that can take a season at sea

nodes.name: Imperial Cartography

effects.target: neighbours' holdings and stacks are visible to the scorer

pursued_when.situation: A neighbour with a grudge and a larger muster; the polity cannot see what it faces, and the map is the cheapest defence.

nodes.earth_ref: surveyed itineraries and charts of the whole realm

nodes.name: Toll Stations

pursued_when.situation: Trade crosses the polity's roads and the seat keeps none of it. The cross-link to chartered companies.

nodes.earth_ref: tolls on trunk roads and river crossings

nodes.name: Bloomery Iron

pursued_when.situation: Ore in the hinterland and the classical rows unopened; the forge is what the ground offers.

nodes.earth_ref: mature by the classical band; iron stops being a treasure

nodes.name: Drill & Levy Rolls

pursued_when.situation: The muster the scorer wants exceeds the manpower ceiling.

nodes.earth_ref: levy rolls; drilled formations

nodes.name: Siegecraft

pursued_when.situation: The campaign the scorer wants ends at a walled seat, and a seat is where a war ends.

nodes.earth_ref: engines and circumvallation; the art of taking a walled place

nodes.name: Wall Circuit

pursued_when.situation: An aggressive neighbour fields stacks that outpower the seat's; the wall is the answer a weaker polity can afford.

nodes.earth_ref: circuit walls and gates around the seat

nodes.name: Quartermasters

pursued_when.situation: Columns lose strength to supply before they lose it to battle.

nodes.earth_ref: supply officers; the baggage train as an institution

nodes.name: Stirrup Cavalry

pursued_when.situation: Grassland in the hinterland and horse already in the roster; the heavy charge is what the ground offers.

nodes.earth_ref: the stirrup; shock cavalry as the medieval military revolution

nodes.name: Pattern-Forged Steel

pursued_when.situation: Ore held, a forge running, and a rival whose stacks match the polity's — quality is the edge the ground offers.

nodes.earth_ref: crucible and pattern steels

nodes.name: Armourers' Guild

pursued_when.situation: Every levy takes more from the labour split than the seat can spare; the trip-hammer of the water wheel is the cross-link.

nodes.earth_ref: water-powered hammers in the armourers' quarter

nodes.name: Stone Fortress

pursued_when.situation: Ground has been lost and the polity is consolidating; it holds what it has by making the seat too expensive to take.

nodes.earth_ref: the stone keep; the fortress answer to shock cavalry

nodes.name: Blast Furnace

pursued_when.situation: Ore and fuel windows both open and steel already forged; the furnace crossing is within arithmetic reach.

nodes.earth_ref: cast iron; the pre-coke furnace

nodes.name: Charcoal Burners

pursued_when.situation: Forest fuel in the hinterland; the road to the furnace.

nodes.earth_ref: managed charcoal for the forge

nodes.name: Iron-Shod Plough

pursued_when.situation: Population near the asymptote on the seat's own region; the first relief any polity buys.

nodes.earth_ref: widespread by the classical band

nodes.name: Irrigation Works

pursued_when.situation: Arable ground with a river through it; the channel is what the ground offers and the seat's food ceiling is what it relieves.

nodes.earth_ref: canal and qanat systems

nodes.name: Temple Stores

effects.target: Granary Doctrine — the surplus is gathered and redistributed by command

pursued_when.situation: Stores fall to nothing after every muster and famine drawdowns recur; the polity chooses stability over depth.

nodes.earth_ref: redistributive storehouses; famine-resistant, markets thin

nodes.name: Open Granaries

effects.target: Granary Doctrine — the surplus is priced and traded

pursued_when.situation: Population well under the asymptote and stores steady; the surplus wants a price, and the polity chooses depth over stability.

nodes.earth_ref: priced grain; markets deepen early, famine risk stays live

nodes.name: Harvest Tallies

pursued_when.situation: The seat does not know what its hinterland yielded; the shared minor under the granary fork, and the link to coinage on the spire.

nodes.earth_ref: harvest accounts; tally sticks and store lists

nodes.name: Water Wheel

pursued_when.situation: Milling and hammering eat the labour split; work detaches from muscle for the first time.

nodes.earth_ref: the first non-muscle prime mover

nodes.name: Three-Field Rotation

pursued_when.situation: Every held region near its asymptote and no unheld ground inside reach; yield per field is the only relief left.

nodes.earth_ref: ~50% arable output gain from rotation

nodes.name: Windmill

pursued_when.situation: Ground without rivers to turn a wheel and labour short for the mill.

nodes.earth_ref: wind as prime mover where the river does not run

nodes.name: Manuring & Fallow

pursued_when.situation: Population climbing on its asymptote; taken on the way to rotation, from either side of the granary fork.

nodes.earth_ref: fallow management and manuring

nodes.name: Land Reclamation

pursued_when.situation: A polity at the asymptote everywhere, roads to every neighbour, and wet or dry ground it cannot yet farm.

nodes.earth_ref: polders, terracing, drainage

nodes.name: Mill Networks

pursued_when.situation: Ore or fuel windows suggest a furnace and the polity is buying the road to it; power in a building before power that moves.

nodes.earth_ref: cam and crank; trip-hammers, fulling, sawing

nodes.name: Physicians' Canon

pursued_when.situation: A drawdown struck the seat's region inside the last rounds; the canon is the first answer.

nodes.earth_ref: a written medical corpus

nodes.name: Shared Measures

pursued_when.situation: Held regions carry shares of another people; a common weight and measure is the first thing they agree on.

nodes.earth_ref: standard weights, measures and the seat's tongue in the market

nodes.name: Provincial Governors

pursued_when.situation: Hinterland far from the seat, carrying foreign shares; the seat needs someone there who answers to it.

nodes.earth_ref: provincial administration; governors who answer to the seat

nodes.name: Paper

pursued_when.situation: Nothing binds and the polity is buying the rate; the record gets cheap.

nodes.earth_ref: the diffusion showpiece; the record becomes cheap to keep

nodes.name: Founded Infirmaries

pursued_when.situation: Drawdowns recur across the holdings; care institutionalises.

nodes.earth_ref: endowed hospitals

nodes.name: Quarantine Doctrine

pursued_when.situation: A drawdown crossed from a neighbour along the polity's own roads; reach carried the plague.

nodes.earth_ref: plague response; isolation as policy

nodes.name: Positional Arithmetic

pursued_when.situation: The polity keeps a record and has the rounds to make calculation cheap.

nodes.earth_ref: the zero; calculation cheapens

nodes.name: Temple Schools

pursued_when.situation: Foreign shares on held ground and a record to teach from; the link to endowed scholarship on the spire.

nodes.earth_ref: schooling attached to the temple

nodes.name: Chartered Companies

effects.target: an entity that outlives its members can own

pursued_when.situation: Trade crosses the polity's roads and coasts and the seat's stores exceed what its campaigns need; the surplus wants an owner that is not the sovereign.

nodes.earth_ref: the Charter Age node — Stage 1's apex

nodes.name: Syncretic Rites

pursued_when.situation: Conquered peoples outnumber the founding culture and cohesion sags with every new seat; the rites of the taken are folded into the seat's own.

nodes.earth_ref: the mixing that a civilisation forms from

nodes.name: Pilgrim Roads

pursued_when.situation: Peoples on held ground who share a shrine but not a seat.

nodes.earth_ref: pilgrimage routes as a common institution
